definition: to be given a chance to do something
description: An outdoor concert at dusk. A young woman in a blue satin top, jeans and white trainers climbs over the metal crowd barrier onto the stage with a huge smile, helped by a young man in a white T-shirt. A young female guitarist in a mustard shirt holds out a microphone to her, and a young singer in a black shirt reaches out to welcome her. She takes the microphone and starts to sing at the front of the stage, while the young man below cheers with his fist up. Coloured spotlights shine from the stage.
